mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) may reduce the contraceptive efficacy of norethindrone through increased metabolism and/or enterohepatic circulation interference, while norethindrone may increase piroxicam levels via CYP2C9 inhibition and increase NSAID-related GI and renal toxicity.
action: Consider alternative analgesia or ensure reliable backup contraception; monitor for breakthrough bleeding and NSAID adverse effects; counsel on GI protection if combination necessary.
